G1_observable_alignment.alignment_semantics: a directional human answer aligned with the mapped observable's direction counts as aligned; SAME against a null expectation counts as aligned; any mismatch counts as misaligned; CANNOT_JUDGE never counts as aligned or misaligned

G3_cannot_judge.rule: SAME, CANNOT_JUDGE and each CANNOT_JUDGE reason are reported separately; the too_close reason is preserved as the participant's original choice and is never auto-converted to SAME

G5_stress_probe.rule: S-T1-STRESS results are reported separately from the three non-stress core probes; no combined overall agreement rate is computed across stress + core

G6_human_disagreement.rule: a persistent human split on a single-axis question is recorded as genuine human disagreement / perceptual boundary; no majority-vote ground truth is created, no participant is ranked, no answer is relabelled

Q-V02-SLIDER-PATH.attend_to: 先看每一边片段里路径较长的几根滑条，再比较两边这些滑条各自单根的跟随路径长度；折返滑条按来回全程计算。
not_asking: 不是比较跟随时间长短
不是把所有滑条路径相加

Q-V02-SLIDER-TIME.question_text: 哪一边较长的那批滑条，单根需要保持跟随更久？
Q-V02-SLIDER-TIME.attend_to: 先看每一边片段里跟随较久的几根滑条，再比较两边这些滑条各自单根的持续跟随时间。
not_asking: 不是把整段跟随时间相加

aggregation_decision.PATH: primary proxy = rule p90 (zero-inclusive). If a human answer matches the slider-row curve p90 direction but not the rule p90 (S-T1-CORE-A: rule p90 EQUAL, slider-row p90 B), it is attributed to the slider-row upper-tail reading and recorded as such — never retro-fitted as the intended metric.
aggregation_decision.TIME: primary proxy = per-slider duration p90. median/total/max are recorded in the matrix for attribution only (S-T1-CORE-A: max/p90 B vs median/total A).

semantic_lock.anti_post_hoc_selection: the proxy for each question is fixed by this document; after human results exist, no re-selection of max/median/p90/total is permitted — disagreements are attributed via the frozen matrix, not by switching metrics
evidence_basis: P1: human direction on B4/B5/B6 matched the upper-tail single-slider follow TIME; the old wording already anchored '较长的一批滑条'
P1.5: S-T1-CORE-A duration p90 vs median point opposite ways — the ambiguity is real and is now locked
P2B matrix: on 3 of 4 core pairs, max/p90/median/total conflict for at least one dimension

Q-V02-SLIDER-PATH.human_construct: upper tail of single-slider follow path length inside the segment (较长的那批滑条; repeats counted as full traversal)
Q-V02-SLIDER-PATH.construct_aligned_measure: slider-only path upper-tail statistic: p90 of ls.lazy_travel_distance_cs_normalised over slider rows only (max as secondary); this is what the wording anchors, not the rule's zero-inclusive population
Q-V02-SLIDER-PATH.current_rule_proxy: segment p90 of ls.lazy_travel_distance_cs_normalised over the ZERO-INCLUSIVE row population (the unchanged current rule input); recorded separately — it is NOT the human construct

Q-V02-SLIDER-TIME.human_construct: upper tail of single-slider follow duration inside the segment (持续跟随较久的那批滑条; full traversal incl. spans)
Q-V02-SLIDER-TIME.construct_aligned_measure: p90 of per-slider slider_total_duration_ms over slider rows only (max as secondary; lazy_travel_time_ms recorded as a cross-check)
Q-V02-SLIDER-TIME.current_rule_proxy: none — the current formal rule does not consume any duration value (recorded as such, not fabricated)

three_layers.note: construct_aligned_measure and current_rule_proxy are different quantities and are never conflated; the frozen attribution matrix reports both

stress_overflow_decision.issue: S-T1-STRESS side B: one context slider overflows the default 8.5s window end by ~74 ms
stress_overflow_decision.decision: FIX_AT_HARNESS_LEVEL: the harness computes a clip-safe equal-length pair window (end extended to cover any slider starting within the +1.5s context, +100ms padding; start shifted so both sides keep the identical 8.5s length). The stress probe stays in the package and is reported separately per G5.
stress_overflow_decision.not_demoted: the probe is NOT demoted; the clip defect is removed, not tolerated
